commands.name: can-i-deploy
commands.summary: Can this version be deployed?

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Check pacts against several provider versions before publishing (POST …/pacts/check).

commands.name: create-environment
commands.summary: Create an environment (POST …/environments) and print its UUID.

commands.name: create-or-update-pacticipant
commands.summary: Create a pacticipant, or update the one with this name, as `pact-broker create-or-update-pacticipant`.

commands.name: create-version-tag
commands.summary: Tag a pacticipant version (PUT /v1/tenants/{t}/pacticipants/{p}/versions/{v}/tags/{tag}), as `pact-broker create-version-tag`.

commands.name: create-webhook
commands.summary: Create a webhook (POST …/webhooks), with `pact-broker create-webhook`'s options.

commands.name: delete-pacticipant
commands.summary: Delete a pacticipant with its versions, pacts and results (DELETE /v1/tenants/{t}/pacticipants/{name}).

commands.name: delete-version
commands.summary: Delete a pacticipant version with its pacts and results (DELETE …/pacticipants/{p}/versions/{v}).

commands.name: describe-version
commands.summary: Describe a pacticipant version: number, branches, tags, build URL, creation time.

commands.name: export-consumer-contract
commands.summary: Export a picker-declared consumer surface as a Pact v4 file (GET …/consumers/{c}/pact).

commands.name: export-postman
commands.summary: Export a pact as a Postman Collection v2.1 (POST …/pact-postman-collections).

commands.name: list-pacticipants
commands.summary: List the workspace's pacticipants (GET /v1/tenants/{t}/pacticipants, every page).

commands.name: migrate
commands.summary: Migrate a Pact Broker or PactFlow workspace into Apiome (POST …/pact-migration/import).

commands.name: publish
commands.summary: Publish pacts for a consumer version (POST …/contracts/publish), as `pact-broker publish`.

commands.name: publish-consumer-contract
commands.summary: Publish a picker-declared consumer surface to the Pact Broker (POST …/consumers/{c}/pact/publish).

commands.name: publish-provider-contract
commands.summary: Publish a provider contract with its self-verification evidence (PUT …/contracts/provider/…).

commands.name: publish-verification-results
commands.summary: Publish a verification report produced elsewhere (POST …/external-verification-results).

commands.name: record-deployment
commands.summary: Record that a version is deployed to an environment (POST …/deployed-versions/environment/{uuid}).

commands.name: record-release
commands.summary: Record that a version is released to an environment (POST …/released-versions/environment/{uuid}).

commands.name: record-support-ended
commands.summary: Record that a released version is no longer supported (PATCH …/released-versions/{uuid}).

commands.name: record-undeployment
commands.summary: Record that a pacticipant is no longer deployed to an environment (PATCH …/deployed-versions/{uuid}).

commands.name: restore-version
commands.summary: Restore a deleted version with its pacts, results and deployments (POST …/versions/{v}/restore).

commands.name: retention preview
commands.summary: Preview what the clean-up rules remove if they ran now (POST …/pact-retention/policy/preview).

commands.name: retention set
commands.summary: Change the clean-up rules; the ones not given stay as saved (PUT …/pact-retention/policy).

commands.name: retention show
commands.summary: Show the clean-up rules, the nightly switch and the restore window (GET …/pact-retention/policy).

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Verify a provider against its pacts with Apiome's hosted verifier (POST …/pact-verifier/…/verify).
